metadata.description: Repo-scoped Cursor plugins for Kibi workflows

plugins.name: kibi-cursor
plugins.description: Optional Cursor adapter for Kibi. Prerequisite: SWI-Prolog 9+ and project-local kibi-cli, kibi-mcp, kibi-core (see docs/install.md). Bundles MCP config, rules, skills, commands, and advisory hooks.

plugins.name: kibi-agent-plugin
plugins.description: Portable Agent Plugins build of Kibi (agent-plugins.org). Packages Kibi's Agent Skills and MCP server for any client that supports the open standard. Prerequisite: SWI-Prolog 9+ and project-local kibi-cli, kibi-mcp, kibi-core (see docs/install.md).
